links.comparator_used: Standard analysis (model fitted on the full dataset, with no account taken of improvements in survival over time); period analysis was a second comparator
links.outcome: 10-year calibration of predicted risk of death from colon cancer and total risk of death in patients diagnosed in 2005
links.effect: The standard approach over-estimated 10-year risk of colon cancer death and total risk of death; calibration was improved with temporal recalibration or period analysis. No numeric estimates were reported in the abstract.
links.quote: The 10-year calibration plots demonstrated that using the standard approach over-estimated the risk of death due to colon cancer and the total risk of death and that calibration was improved using temporal recalibration or period analysis.

design_hint: temporal recalibration of risk model baseline
